_notes._: Reviewed known violations. Each rule says why it is accepted for now and where it is tracked. Counts are violating nodes per rule per component; see specs/axe.spec.ts.
_notes.label: Untracked: the compact void-color-picker's hex input has no label.
_notes.landmark-banner-is-top-level: Untracked: void-banner is role=banner, a page landmark, even when used as an in-page notice inside <main>.
_notes.nested-interactive: Untracked duplicate roles: the color-picker host is a focusable widget around native controls; a void-button wrapping an <a> (link button) is a button around a link.
_notes.scrollable-region-focusable: Untracked: void-scroll-area's viewport cannot be scrolled by keyboard unless its content is focusable.
_notes.target-size: Untracked: sidebar and breadcrumb links, carousel indicators and the compact colour input are under 24x24 px; the link button's anchor is partly covered by its host's padding.
